title: Whole-number solutions of 3x + 5y = 47
caption: Every point of the line 3x + 5y = 47 solves the equation, but only some have whole-number coordinates: (4, 7), (9, 4) and (14, 1), each step 5 across and 3 down.
alt: The line 3x + 5y = 47 on a grid with the three points (4, 7), (9, 4) and (14, 1) marked.
description: The line 3x + 5y = 47 crosses the axes at (0, 9.4) and (15.67, 0).
y = 7 gives 3x = 12, so (4, 7) is a solution.
Each step of t adds 5 to x and takes 3 from y: (9, 4), then (14, 1).
Another step would make y negative, so there are exactly three non-negative solutions.

checks.name: (4, 7), (9, 4) and (14, 1) lie on the line through (0, 47/5) and (47/3, 0), 3x + 5y = 47
